This page is generated from [`schema/draft/schema.ts`](https://github.com/agent-space-protocol/agentspaceprotocol/blob/main/schema/draft/schema.ts), the single source of the protocol's messages. The same source produces [`schema.json`](https://github.com/agent-space-protocol/agentspaceprotocol/blob/main/schema/draft/schema.json). Every object accepts members it does not list: unknown fields must be ignored and passed on unchanged.

## Messages from participants

### ParticipantHello

The participant's half of the handshake, the first message on a connection.
The participant states the versions it supports for each part and, optionally, its identity.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"hello"` | yes |  |
| `parts` | [SupportedParts](#supportedparts) | yes | The versions the participant supports for each part. |
| `participant` | `string` |  | The participant's public key, if it has one. Proven with `proof` in `join`. |
| `token` | `string` |  | A local token, used instead of a key between processes on one computer. |
| `client` | [Software](#software) |  | The participant's software, for logs. |

### Join

Start a presence, or resume one after a disconnect. Answered with an `outcome` whose result is a
`JoinResult`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"join"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `role` | `string` |  | The role asked for. The space decides the role given. |
| `presentation` | [Presentation](#presentation) |  | Presentation preferences. |
| `proof` | `string` |  | Proof of identity: the unpadded base64url Ed25519 signature, by the key named in `hello`, of the UTF-8 bytes of `asp-v0 join <space> <nonce>`. |
| `resume` | `string` |  | Resume a presence kept after a disconnect, with the token from its `JoinResult`. |
| `pass` | `string` |  | A pass signed by another space, for a participant arriving through a door. |

### Leave

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"leave"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `cancel` | `boolean` |  | Whether actions under way are cancelled with it. Otherwise they run to their own outcomes. |

### Observe

Ask for one observation in the forms asked for. Answered with `observation`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"observe"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |

### Subscribe

Subscribe to the record from a sequence number on: every entry this presence may see is pushed
as an `event`, in order. A new `subscribe` replaces the previous one. Answered with `subscribed`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"subscribe"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `from` | `integer` |  | The first sequence number wanted; the next new entry when absent. |
| `kinds` | `string`[] |  | Only these kinds of entry. All kinds when absent. |

### Act

An action. Answered by intermediate states and exactly one final `outcome`. Sending the same ID
again only returns the first outcome or the current intermediate state.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"act"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `verb` | `string` | yes | The verb, named in the vocabulary. |
| `object` | `string` |  | The thing acted on. |
| `args` | map of any |  | The parameters, as the verb's schema describes. |
| `basis` | `integer` |  | The record sequence number of the observation the action is based on. |
| `deadline` | `number` |  | How long the action may take, in seconds from when the space receives it. When it passes the space stops the action. |

### Edit

An edit: structured changes, or a sentence. Gets a final outcome like an action.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"edit"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `changes` | [Change](#change)[] |  | Structured changes, committed atomically. |
| `sentence` | `string` |  | A sentence, translated by the space into structured changes. |
| `basis` | `integer` |  | The observation the edit is based on. |
| `deadline` | `number` |  | How long the edit may take, in seconds. |

### Cancel

Ask to cancel an action or edit of this participant. Cancelling is only a request: the action
still gets its own final outcome, `cancelled` if it stopped, `done` if it finished first, or
`unknown`. Has no ID and no answer of its own.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"cancel"` | yes |  |
| `action` | `string` | yes | The ID of the action, edit or stream to cancel. |

### RecordRequest

Fetch the record by sequence numbers or by time. Answered with `entries`, or with an `outcome`
`refused` with the reason `expired` when the range starts before the earliest entry kept.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"record"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `from` | `integer` |  | The first sequence number. |
| `to` | `integer` |  | The last sequence number. |
| `since` | `string` |  | Entries appended at or after this time. |
| `until` | `string` |  | Entries appended before this time. |
| `limit` | `integer` |  | The most entries to return. |

| `type` | `"stream"` | yes |  |

| `form` | `string` | yes | The continuous form, as declared in the vocabulary. |
| `rate` | `number` |  | Frames or samples a second. |

### Offer

Capability `doors`: hand a thing over to this space, or ask to pass through one of its doors.

- With `thing`, the sender (another space, acting as a participant) offers the thing; the outcome
  is `done` once this space has taken it and recorded `asp.take`, with an `OfferResult`.
- With `door` and no `thing`, a participant asks to pass through the door; the outcome is `done`
  with a `PassResult`, and the presence ends here.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"offer"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `thing` | [OfferedThing](#offeredthing) |  | The thing handed over, with the chain of its parent types. |
| `door` | `string` |  | The door. |

### Take

Capability `doors`: ask whether this space took an offer. The giving side asks after a
disconnect midway; the receiving side's record decides. The outcome's result is a `TakeResult`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"take"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `offer` | `string` | yes | The ID of the `offer`. |

## Messages from spaces

### SpaceHello

The space's half of the handshake. It gives the negotiated version of each part, the capability
table, the hash of the vocabulary, the state of the record and a random value the participant
signs to prove its identity.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"hello"` | yes |  |
| `space` | `string` | yes | The space's identifier: its key's identity, or an address-like name for a space without a key. |
| `parts` | [NegotiatedParts](#negotiatedparts) | yes | The version used for each part. Parts without a common version are left out. |
| `supported` | [SupportedParts](#supportedparts) |  | The versions the space supports for each part. |
| `capabilities` | [Capabilities](#capabilities) | yes | The capability table. |
| `vocabulary` | `string` | yes | The hash of the vocabulary. |
| `record` | [RecordInfo](#recordinfo) | yes | The state of the record. |
| `nonce` | `string` | yes | A random value, at least 16 bytes in base64url, that a participant with a key signs in `join`. |
| `key` | `string` |  | The space's public key, which signs passes and saves. |
| `server` | [Software](#software) |  | The space's software, for logs. |

### Observation

One observation: a projection of the state for this presence.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"observation"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `seq` | `integer` | yes | The record sequence number the observation is at. Observations at the same number have the same content. |
| `confirmed` | `string` |  | When an external state was last confirmed. |
| `structure` | [Structure](#structure) | yes | The structure, always present. |
| `forms` | map of [FormContent](#formcontent) |  | The other forms asked for, by name. |
| `senses` | map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) |  | The values of derived observations placed by this presence, by name. |

### Outcome

The final outcome of an action, an edit or any other request. Exactly one per ID.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"outcome"` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer. Unique for the participant that sends it, for at least as long as the space keeps its record. |
| `end` | [End](#end) | yes | The final outcome. |
| `seq` | `integer` |  | The sequence number of the outcome's record entry, when it is recorded. |
| `reason` | [Reason](#reason) |  | Why, for every end except `done`, and optionally for `done`. |
| `result` | [JSONValue](#jsonvalue)[] \| map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) \| `null` \| `string` \| `number` \| `boolean` |  | The result of `done`. |
| `effects` | [Effect](#effect)[] |  | The effects that did happen, for `failed`, `cancelled` and `unknown`. |
| `events` | `number`[] |  | The sequence numbers of the events it caused. |
| `known` | map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) |  | For `unknown`: what is known. |
| `unconfirmed` | `string`[] |  | For `unknown`: what is not confirmed. |

## Types

### AddChange

Add a thing.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | `"add"` | yes |  |
| `thing` | [Thing](#thing) | yes | The new thing. |

### Capabilities

The capability table of a space, declared item by item. A capability that is not declared is
unsupported: using it gets `refused` with the reason `unsupported` (or, for a message without
an ID, an `error` with the code `unsupported`). A capability declared with an empty object is
read at its most conservative value.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `"external"` \| `"held"` |  | Where the state is: `held` by the space itself, or `external`, reached by an adapter. |
| `lifetime` | `"disposable"` \| `"lasting"` |  | Whether the space lasts or is thrown away after use. |
| `participants` | [ParticipantsCapability](#participantscapability) |  | Participants, roles and presences. |
| `forms` | `string`[] |  | The observation forms the space offers. `structure` is always available and need not be listed. Each name refers to a form declared in the vocabulary, which gives its media type. |
| `inputs` | `string`[] |  | The media types an action's parameters may carry, such as `audio/ogg` or `image/png`. |
| `edit` | [EditCapability](#editcapability) |  | Editing the world itself. |
| `snapshot` | [SnapshotCapability](#snapshotcapability) |  | Saving and restoring. |
| `episode` | [EpisodeCapability](#episodecapability) |  | Episodes started from a task and a seed. |
| `pace` | [PaceCapability](#pacecapability) |  | The pace of the space. |
| `consent` | [ConsentCapability](#consentcapability) |  | Actions that wait for another participant's agreement before they run. |
| `pause` | [PauseCapability](#pausecapability) |  | Holding an action under way and continuing it later. |
| `senses` | [SensesCapability](#sensescapability) |  | Derived observations placed by participants. |
| `views` | [ViewsCapability](#viewscapability) |  | The space's own interfaces, for hosts to embed. |
| `doors` | [DoorsCapability](#doorscapability) |  | Links to other spaces. |

### CapabilityKey

Type: `"consent"` \| `"doors"` \| `"edit"` \| `"episode"` \| `"forms"` \| `"inputs"` \| `"lifetime"` \| `"pace"` \| `"participants"` \| `"pause"` \| `"senses"` \| `"snapshot"` \| `"state"` \| `"views"`

| `sentences` | `boolean` |  | Whether edits written as a sentence are taken. |

### Effect

An effect that did happen, listed by `failed`, `cancelled` and `unknown`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thing` | `string` |  | The thing affected, when there is one. |
| `text` | `string` |  | One sentence describing the effect. |

### EffectClass

The class of a verb's effect, from which a participant decides whether to ask its owner first.

- `read`: reads only.
- `change`: changes this space.
- `send`: sends to others: a new recipient, forwarding, publishing.
- `spend`: spends money.
- `irreversible`: cannot be undone.

Type: `"change"` \| `"irreversible"` \| `"read"` \| `"send"` \| `"spend"`

### End

The five final outcomes.

- `done`: carried out; has the result and the events it caused.
- `refused`: nothing happened; decided before any effect.
- `failed`: tried and not achieved; lists the effects that did happen.
- `cancelled`: confirmed stopped; lists the effects from before it stopped.
- `unknown`: may or may not have happened; says what is known and what is not confirmed.

Type: `"cancelled"` \| `"done"` \| `"failed"` \| `"refused"` \| `"unknown"`

### Entry

One entry of the record. The envelope follows CloudEvents 1.0 in its JSON format: `id`,
`source`, `type` and `specversion` are always present. ASP adds `seq`, `aspcore`, `cause`,
`things` and `roles`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `specversion` | `"1.0"` | yes | The CloudEvents version, always `1.0`. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The entry's ID: its sequence number written as a decimal string. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Who caused the entry. |
| `type` | `string` | yes | The kind of entry. Kinds of the protocol start with `asp.`; the space's own kinds of event are named in its vocabulary. |
| `time` | `string` | yes | When the entry was appended. |
| `seq` | `integer` | yes | The record sequence number. |
| `aspcore` | `integer` | yes | The version of the core part the entry was written with. |
| `cause` | `integer` |  | The sequence number of the entry that led to this one, so anything can be traced back to where it started. |
| `things` | `string`[] |  | The things involved. |
| `roles` | `string`[] |  | If present, only these roles receive the entry. |
| `datacontenttype` | `string` |  | The media type of `data`, `application/json` when absent. |
| `data` | [JSONValue](#jsonvalue)[] \| map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) \| `null` \| `string` \| `number` \| `boolean` |  | The content of the entry. |
| `dataref` | `string` |  | Large content stored only as a hash and fetched with `blob`. |

### EntrySource

The source of a record entry: `space` for the space itself, `presence/<presence>` for a
participant's presence, and `outside` or `outside/<who>` for participants outside the protocol.

Type: `string`

Pattern: `^(space|presence/.+|outside(/.+)?)$`

### EpisodeCapability

The `episode` capability.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tasks` | `string`[] |  | The tasks an episode can be started from. |
| `evaluator` | `string` |  | The role that receives scores. Defaults to `evaluator`. |

### EventDecl

A kind of event.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | `string` |  | One line describing the event. |
| `data` | [JSONSchemaObject](#jsonschemaobject) |  | The content of the event, as a JSON Schema. |
| `perceived` | `"all"` \| `"range"` |  | Who perceives it: everyone, or only those within range of the things involved. |

### FormContent

One observation in a form other than structure. Either `data` or `blob` is present.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `string` | yes | The media type, as declared for the form in the vocabulary. |
| `data` | `string` |  | The content: text as is, binary content as base64. |
| `blob` | `string` |  | Large content stored by hash and fetched with `blob`. |

### FormDecl

An observation form.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `string` | yes | The media type of the form. |
| `continuous` | `boolean` |  | Whether it is continuous, subscribed to as a stream. |
| `line` | `string` |  | One line describing the form. |

### Hash

A content hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Structured content is
hashed in its RFC 8785 canonical JSON form.

Type: `string`

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

### Hidden

What a role does not see.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `properties` | `string`[] |  | Property names left out of every thing this role observes. |
| `events` | `string`[] |  | Kinds of record entries this role never receives. |

### Identity

The identity of a participant or a space: `ed25519:` followed by the unpadded base64url form of
the 32-byte Ed25519 public key. A participant that connects with a local token is shown as
`token:<name>`; one with neither is anonymous and is known only by its presence.

Type: `string`

Pattern: `^(ed25519:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}|token:.+)$`

### JSONSchemaObject

A JSON Schema (2020-12) describing a value.

Type: map of any

### JSONValue

Any JSON value.

Type: [JSONValue](#jsonvalue)[] \| map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) \| `null` \| `string` \| `number` \| `boolean`

### JoinResult

The result of a successful `join`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `presence` | `string` | yes | The ID of the presence. |
| `role` | `string` | yes | The role given. |
| `participant` | `string` |  | The participant's identity as the space knows it. |
| `range` | [JSONValue](#jsonvalue)[] \| map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) \| `null` \| `string` \| `number` \| `boolean` |  | The range of perception, when the space limits it. |
| `presentation` | map of [PresentationUse](#presentationuse) |  | What was done with each presentation preference. |
| `resume` | `string` | yes | A secret token to resume this presence within the grace period. |
| `resumed` | `boolean` |  | Whether an existing presence was resumed. |
| `head` | `integer` | yes | The latest record sequence number when the presence started. |

### NamespaceInfo

A namespace of a vocabulary and the package it comes from.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `string` | yes | The package's version, `major.minor.patch`. Within a major version a package only adds. |
| `line` | `string` |  | One line describing the namespace. |

### NegotiatedParts

The version used for each part, the highest version both sides support. A part with no
version in common is left out and counts as unsupported for this connection.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `core` | `integer` | yes | The version of the core used. |

### OfferResult

The result of a taken offer.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thing` | `string` | yes | The ID the thing has in this space. |
| `as` | `string` | yes | The type it is treated as, the nearest known one. |
| `take` | `integer` | yes | The sequence number of the `asp.take` entry. |

### OfferedThing

A thing as handed over through a door.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parents` | `string`[] |  | Its parent types, nearest first, so the receiver can fall back to one it knows. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The ID of the thing. |
| `type` | `string` | yes | The type of the thing, named in the vocabulary. |
| `confirmed` | `string` |  | When an external state confirmed this thing, if it differs from the observation. |

### PaceCapability

The `pace` capability.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_hz` | `number` |  | The most actions a second for each presence. |
| `clock` | `"stepped"` \| `"wall"` |  | Whether time follows the wall clock or advances in steps. |
| `step_seconds` | `number` |  | How long one step is, in seconds, when the clock advances in steps. |

### PartName

The names of the parts of the protocol. `core` covers entering, observing, acting, editing,
outcomes, events, the record and the vocabulary. Every other part belongs to the capability of
the same name. A part name outside this list must carry a namespace.

Type: `string`

### PartVersion

An integer version of one part of the protocol.

Type: `integer`

### ParticipantsCapability

The `participants` capability.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | `integer` |  | How many presences at most. |
| `roles` | map of [Role](#role) |  | The roles of the space, by name. Defaults are `owner`, `member` and `guest`. |
| `default_role` | `string` |  | The role given when `join` asks for none. |
| `outside` | `boolean` |  | Whether there are participants outside the protocol, whose changes appear as events with the source `outside`. |
| `grace_seconds` | `number` |  | How long a presence is kept after its connection drops, in seconds. Within this time the participant can resume the presence with `join` and its `resume` token. |

### PassResult

The result of passing through a door.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | `string` | yes | The address of the space on the other side. |
| `pass` | `string` | yes | The pass, signed by this space, to give in `join` over there. |

### PauseCapability

The `pause` capability.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verbs` | `string`[] |  | The verbs whose actions can be paused. Absent means every verb. |

### Presentation

Presentation preferences a participant hands over on entering. The space decides whether to
use them as they are, convert them or use its own default.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  | A name. |
| `avatar` | `string` |  | An avatar image, by hash. |
| `model` | `string` |  | A VRM model, by hash. |
| `line` | `string` |  | One line describing the participant. |

### PresentationUse

What the space did with each presentation preference.

Type: `"converted"` \| `"default"` \| `"ignored"` \| `"used"`

### ProtocolReason

The reasons defined by the protocol. Any other reason code carries a namespace.

- `unsupported`: a capability, part, message or verb the space does not have.
- `forbidden`: the presence's role may not do this.
- `malformed`: the message does not match the schema or the verb's parameters.
- `stale`: the observation named by `basis` is out of date and the verb refuses stale actions.
- `constraint`: the change would break a constraint; nothing was changed.
- `deadline`: the deadline, or the time to wait for consent, passed.
- `closed`: the space closed, or the presence ended.
- `restarted`: the space restarted and could not confirm the outcome.
- `expired`: the record no longer keeps what was asked for.

Type: `"closed"` \| `"constraint"` \| `"deadline"` \| `"expired"` \| `"forbidden"` \| `"malformed"` \| `"restarted"` \| `"stale"` \| `"unsupported"`

### QualifiedName

A namespaced name: a vocabulary namespace, a dot, and the local name, for example `chat.reply`.
Names that start with `asp.` belong to the protocol.

Type: `string`

Pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)+$`

### Reason

A reason: a code and one sentence.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | yes | A protocol reason, or a namespaced code such as `onebot.timeout`. |
| `text` | `string` |  | One sentence for people and models. |
| `data` | [JSONValue](#jsonvalue)[] \| map of [JSONValue](#jsonvalue) \| `null` \| `string` \| `number` \| `boolean` |  | Details, such as the name of the broken constraint. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `earliest` | `integer` | yes | The earliest sequence number still kept. Queries before it are answered with `expired`. |
| `keep_seconds` | `null` \| `number` | yes | How long entries are kept, in seconds; `null` means for ever. |

The ID of a request: an action, an edit or any other message that expects an answer.

Type: `string`

| `consent` | `boolean` |  | Whether this role may agree to or refuse waiting actions (capability `consent`). |
| `hide` | [Hidden](#hidden) |  | What this role does not see in observations and in the record. |

A record sequence number. The record of a space starts at 1 and every entry takes the next number.

A verb.
